newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-ARGENTINE PLAYERS STAY ON STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARGENTINE PLAYERS STAY ON STRIKE.

text.p: Argentine soccer fans face a second blank weekend as players remain on strike.

With only a handful of league matches remaining, the players refused to play ago 10 days ago and said they would not return until first division Deportivo Espanol allow six players, whose contracts expired on June 30, to move to other clubs.
The Argentine Labour Ministry ruled the strike illegal on Thursday but Juan Sune, the lawyer representing the players' union, said: "Soccer will be not be played until the six players are released."
